meals.name: ALDI Lemon-Herb Chicken Quinoa Bowls
meals.macroFit: 5 oz lean chicken with high-fiber quinoa/chickpeas and lots of vegetables.
instructions: Cook quinoa while the chicken cooks.
Slice chicken thin and season with lemon juice, garlic, oregano, pepper, and a small pinch of salt.
Sear chicken 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Quick-roast or sauté peppers; chop cucumber and spinach.
Build bowls with quinoa, chickpeas, vegetables, chicken, and lemon-yogurt sauce.

meals.name: ALDI Sheet-Pan Drumsticks with Sweet Potatoes
meals.protein: Kirkwood Fresh Family Pack Chicken Drumsticks
meals.salePrice: $0.99/lb surfaced in current listing; confirm locally
meals.macroFit: Use two smaller drumsticks per adult-equivalent serving, pull skin after cooking, and keep the carb clean with sweet potatoes.
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F and line two sheet pans.
Season drumsticks with paprika, garlic, pepper, and a little salt; cube sweet potatoes small.
Roast chicken and sweet potatoes 25 to 30 minutes, flipping once.
Microwave-steam or sauté green beans while the sheet pan finishes.
Serve with mixed greens; remove chicken skin for a leaner plate.

meals.name: HT Fish Fillet Brown Rice Taco Bowls
meals.salePrice: Weekly ad fish-fillets feature; exact Belmont price not exposed
meals.macroFit: Lean fish plus beans/rice gives a balanced, high-protein bowl without heavy sauces.
instructions: Season fish with cumin, chili powder, garlic, lime, and pepper.
Pan-sear or air-fry fish until flaky, usually 8 to 12 minutes depending on thickness.
Warm brown rice and rinsed black beans.
Toss slaw with lime juice and a spoonful of Greek yogurt.
Build bowls with rice, beans, slaw, tomatoes, and fish.

meals.name: ALDI Salmon Burger Power Plates
meals.protein: Fremont Fish Market Wild Caught Alaska Salmon Burgers
meals.salePrice: Current weekly-ad item; price not exposed via lightweight fetch
meals.macroFit: Pre-portioned salmon patties make a quick 4 oz protein plate; choose the cleaner flavor/ingredient list available.
instructions: Cook farro or brown rice.
Air-fry or skillet-cook salmon burgers according to package directions.
Steam broccoli until bright green and tender-crisp.
Toss spinach with lemon juice, pepper, and sliced avocado.
Plate grains, broccoli, salad, and salmon burgers.

meals.name: HT Rotisserie Chicken Mediterranean Pitas
meals.salePrice: Weekly ad rotisserie feature; exact Belmont price not exposed
meals.macroFit: Pull mostly breast meat and pair with whole-grain pita, lentils, and fresh vegetables.
instructions: Pull rotisserie chicken meat and remove skin for a cleaner plate.
Warm pitas and lentils.
Chop romaine, cucumbers, tomatoes, and red onion if using.
Mix Greek yogurt with lemon juice, garlic, dill, and pepper.
Stuff pitas with chicken and vegetables; serve lentils on the side or tucked in.

meals.name: HT USDA Choice Beef & Broccoli Soba Stir-Fry
meals.protein: Harris Teeter USDA Choice beef weekly-ad feature
meals.salePrice: Weekly ad USDA Choice beef feature; exact Belmont price not exposed
meals.macroFit: Keeps beef at 4 oz/person and stretches the meal with vegetables and buckwheat noodles.
instructions: Cook soba noodles and rinse briefly.
Slice beef thin across the grain; season with ginger, garlic, pepper, and low-sodium tamari.
Stir-fry beef quickly in a hot skillet, then remove to a plate.
Stir-fry broccoli, snap peas, and carrots until crisp-tender.
Toss noodles, vegetables, and beef together; add extra tamari only as needed.
